{"id": "64ab09ef-d046-4c92-b20d-dac701efee68", "role": "assistant", "block_type": "thinking", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "I'm looking at the trail configuration data, noting it's multi-region and actively logging, with event selectors capturing all management events plus S3 object-level data events.
